title: The running card of a Build tool call stops asking for a job the site does not have
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-site-build-core/test/card-poll.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines `pass` and `fail`.
expect: The run exits 0 and its summary reads `fail 0`.
`a running call with no job on the site stops after the first read` passes.
`a form-sending call never reads the job: its card is the form line` passes.
`a running site request with no build reads as an update, not as a build starting` passes.

`a first read that failed on the network keeps the running card polling, more slowly` passes (review fix M2: before it, a first read that failed read as no job and the card froze on "Starting the build…").

`only the host's NO_JOB answer reads as no job; every other failure is unreadable` passes: 200 → job, 404 NO_JOB → none; 404 without NO_JOB, 401, 500, 503, a thrown fetch and a non-JSON 404 → unreadable.
evidence: P1 stand 02/10/2026 (tasks/evidence/site-changes/P1/stand2/ui/browser-errors.txt): 53 404s, ~18 per session, on scem1002 — the agent's `tracy_site_build_emdash` call `request site.rebuild` (session-2b6ca9eb…) rendered BuildCard, which polled GET job every 1.5 s for the whole rebuild on a site that has no build job (no docs/agents/build on the site).
fence: card-poll.mjs: no read for `ask`; stop only on the host's own 404 NO_JOB before any job was found (job-read.mjs tells it apart from a read that failed, which is read again after 5 s); follow a found job every 1.5 s while the call runs. One NO_JOB 404 per such card remains — it is the honest answer of the first read.

tests: a running call with no job on the site stops after the first read
a running call with a job keeps following it; a settled one reads once
a first read that failed on the network keeps the running card polling, more slowly
only the host's NO_JOB answer reads as no job; every other failure is unreadable
